title: Meena Kumari's birth chart
metaDescription: Meena Kumari's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.5° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 8.5° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 8.5° Leo — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that the Sun, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 5.5° Leo, Venus was at 5.5° Virgo, Mars was at 14.4° Libra. Read together: thought that arrives already in motion; attraction that grows by reliability; effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mars and Saturn: 1.1° from an exact trine. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Jupiter sextile Pluto at 1.4°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 3.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Leo at 8.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Virgo at 5.5° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Libra at 14.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Virgo at 22.0° is in detriment; Saturn in Aquarius at 13.4° is in domicile. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 fire, 3 earth, 2 air, 1 water by element and 3 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal by modality. Mercury and Saturn were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Scorpio into Sagittarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.5° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
